title: ワイヤー買い物カート
description: 実際に隙間のあるワイヤーバスケット、可動式に見える後部ゲート、下段トレーと4つのキャスターを備えたカート。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 繰り返し部品は材質と構成単位ごとに統合済み。
descriptionEn: Shopping trolley with genuinely open tapered wire basket, rear nesting gate, lower wire tray, tubular chassis and four detailed swivel casters. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Repeated static details are grouped by material and assembly; the procedural source retains the editable construction.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
